04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, percentile reference lines, and a marginal box plot all feel considered, but the top-earner callout labels tangle and 'Sam Q.' is clipped at the right edge, and the percentile tick labels overlap the subtitle text.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for skewed income data, dot size is uniform (no lie factor), percentile lines and IQR box are data-driven, colorblind-safe palette used, and synthetic data is labeled — only weakness is a hardcoded xScale domain [14000,550000] rather than d3.extent-derived bounds, which is acceptable for a synthetic demo.
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Simulation is fully pre-computed and static; the only interaction is a lightweight pointer-event tooltip that updates only CSS position, raising no update-storm, stale-scale, feedback-loop, mid-transition, or touch-fight risks.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: Single view, 4-color colorblind-safe palette with clear separation, pre-computed force layout avoids animation chaos, and the marginal box plot adds context without overload; 5 simultaneous leader-line callouts in the sparse high-income tail create minor clutter but don't obscure the main swarm.
